title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 2: Solomon's agreement with Huram king of Tyre for timber and a skilled craftsman to build the temple.

questions.text: How many stone cutters in the mountains did Solomon count out?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:2 says Solomon counted out eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains.

questions.text: To whom did Solomon send a message about building the house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:3 says Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre.

questions.text: What had Huram sent to David, according to Solomon's message?
questions.explanation: Solomon reminded Huram that he had sent David cedars to build him a house to dwell in.

answers.text: Cedars to build him a house

questions.text: According to verses 5-6, why is no one able to build God a house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:5-6 says our God is great, and asks who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain him.

answers.text: The land had no stone left for building
The people of Israel were too few
Heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain him
The priests had no plans for such a house

questions.text: Which trees does verse 8 ask to be sent out of Lebanon?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:8 asks for cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon.

questions.text: How much beaten wheat is promised to the cutters who cut timber?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:10 promises the cutters who cut timber twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat.

questions.text: According to Huram's written answer, why had Yahweh made Solomon king?
questions.explanation: Huram wrote, "Because Yahweh loves his people, he has made you king over them."

answers.text: Because David had asked for it
Because Solomon was the oldest son
Because Tyre had made a treaty with Israel

questions.text: The skillful man Huram sent was the son of a woman of the daughters of whom?
questions.explanation: In 2 Chronicles 2:12-14 Huram says the skillful man he sent was the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre.

questions.text: To which place would the wood be brought in rafts by sea?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:16 says the wood would be brought in rafts by sea to Joppa, and then carried up to Jerusalem.

questions.text: How many foreigners did Solomon find in the land of Israel when he counted them?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:17 says they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

answers.text: One hundred twenty-three thousand six hundred
One hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred
